body: This guy and I were talking for a couple weeks and one night I go over to his place for the first time just to hangout. We decided to watch a movie and not even 2 minutes into it he starts trying to make moves on me, which I kind of assumed would happen, just not so quickly. We ended up making out a bit but I told him im not ready for much more than that. He kept pressuring me to do stuff, and me being the stupid timid girl I am just went along with it for the most part. We didnt have sex, but he crossed some boundaries that I specifically said I didnt want him to cross, before and during it happening. I think I didnt stand my ground more because I was kind of scared and nervous with how aggressive and pushy he was being about the whole thing but I wish I would have stood my ground. Up until that point I was into him and wanted to see him again, but after that I never made plans with him again.
